frames.narration: The app asks the ambassador for the EUR rate. It does not call the partner itself.
The first call to the partner fails.
The ambassador retries. The second call works, so the app gets its rate.
A later request meets three failures in a row. The ambassador gives up and tells the app clearly.
The circuit is now open: the next request is refused at once and the struggling partner is left alone.
The app gets a quick 'unavailable'. On the next request the ambassador sends one probe call, and closes the circuit when the partner answers.
